name: Time-only watch
definition: analogue wristwatch with two or three hands, with or without a date window, and none of the defining functions of the other leaves.

name: Digital watch
definition: wristwatch whose time display is digital; stopwatch and alarm modes standard on the form do not move it.

name: One-hand watch
definition: wristwatch that shows the time with a single hand.

name: Jumping-hours watch
definition: wristwatch that shows the hour as a numeral that jumps in a window.

name: Diver's watch
definition: wristwatch with a unidirectional timing bezel and at least 100 m water resistance, or conforming to ISO 6425.

name: Chronograph
definition: wristwatch with a chronograph mechanism that starts, stops and resets an elapsed-time hand or register.

name: Flyback chronograph
definition: chronograph that can be reset and restarted with one push while running.

name: Split-seconds chronograph (double chronograph, rattrapante)
definition: chronograph with a second seconds hand that can be stopped separately to time intermediate intervals.

name: GMT watch
definition: wristwatch with an extra hand or display showing a second time zone, usually on a 24-hour scale.

name: World-time watch
definition: wristwatch that shows the time in all world time zones at once, with a city ring.

name: Moon-phase watch
definition: wristwatch with a moon-phase display.

name: Annual-calendar watch
definition: wristwatch whose calendar corrects itself for months of 30 and 31 days and needs setting once a year.

name: Perpetual-calendar watch
definition: wristwatch whose calendar corrects itself for month lengths and leap years.

name: Alarm watch
definition: wristwatch with a mechanical alarm that sounds at a set time.

name: Minute-repeater watch
definition: wristwatch that strikes the hours, quarters and minutes on demand.

name: Tourbillon watch
definition: wristwatch whose escapement turns in a rotating cage (tourbillon).

name: Grande-complication watch
definition: wristwatch with at least one timing, one astronomical and one striking complication.

name: Open-face pocket watch
definition: pocket watch whose crystal has no protective cover.

name: Hunter-case pocket watch
definition: pocket watch with a hinged metal lid that covers the crystal.

name: Demi-hunter pocket watch
definition: hunter-case pocket watch whose lid has a window or glazed centre through which the hands can be read.

name: Coin watch
definition: watch built into a case made from or shaped as a coin.

name: Longcase clock (grandfather clock)
definition: tall floor-standing clock with the pendulum and weights in a long case.

name: Mantel clock
definition: clock made to stand on a mantelpiece or shelf.

name: Bracket clock
definition: portable spring-driven table clock with a carrying handle, made to stand on a table or wall bracket.

name: Carriage clock
definition: small spring-driven travelling clock in a glazed metal case with a top handle.

name: Desk clock
definition: small clock made to stand on a desk.

name: Alarm clock
definition: table or bedside clock that sounds at a set time.

name: Digital clock
definition: table or shelf clock with a digital time display.

name: Skeleton clock
definition: clock whose open frame shows the movement with no case around it (A-25).

name: Wall clock
definition: wall-mounted clock with no distinctive case form of the kinds below.

name: Dial clock
definition: wall clock with a large dial in a round case, with or without a drop case below.

name: Wall regulator
definition: precision wall clock with a long pendulum in a tall glazed case.

name: Cuckoo clock
definition: wall clock whose striking sounds a cuckoo call, with a moving bird.

name: Lantern clock
definition: weight-driven wall clock in a brass lantern-shaped case with a bell on top.

name: Tavern clock
definition: large wall clock with a big painted dial and a trunk below, made for public rooms.

name: Travel clock
definition: small clock made to be carried on journeys, often folding or in a case.

name: Marine chronometer
definition: precision timekeeper made to keep time at sea for navigation.

name: Tower or turret clock
definition: clock fixed to a building, with a movement driving one or more exterior dials.

name: Stopwatch
definition: hand-held instrument that measures an elapsed interval.

name: Hourglass
definition: timepiece that measures an interval by sand running between two glass bulbs.

name: Sundial
definition: instrument that shows the time by the sun's shadow on a scale, portable, pocket, wall, horizontal or equatorial.

name: Garden sundial
definition: sundial made to stand or hang in a garden or park, including those sold as garden ornaments, with a working gnomon.

name: Game clock (chess clock)
definition: pair of linked clocks that times each player's moves in a game.

name: Time clock (attendance clock)
definition: clock that records the times workers arrive and leave.

name: Atomic clock
definition: laboratory time standard regulated by an atomic resonance.

name: Watch strap
definition: band of leather, textile, rubber or other flexible material made to hold a watch on the wrist.

name: Watch bracelet
definition: metal link band made to hold a watch on the wrist.

name: Watch winder
definition: powered stand that holds one automatic watch and keeps it wound.

name: Watch dial
definition: dial made to be fitted to a watch.

name: Watch movement
definition: movement (calibre) made to be fitted in a watch.

name: Watch crystal
definition: glass, sapphire or plastic crystal made to cover a watch dial.

name: Watch case
definition: case made to house a watch movement.

name: Watch chain
definition: chain (Albert chain, fob chain) made to attach a pocket watch.
